scenes.title: Getting ready for your procedure
scenes.narration: Hello Imran. This video helps you get ready for your colonoscopy at Brackenridge. It takes about two minutes. You can pause it, turn on captions, or ask a question at any time.
scenes.speech: Hello Imran. This video helps you get ready for your colonoscopy at Brackenridge. It takes about two minutes. You can pause it, turn on captions, or ask a question at any time.

scenes.title: What happens
scenes.narration: A thin, flexible tube with a camera is used to look at the lining of your large bowel. You'll have medicine to make you relaxed and drowsy. You won't be fully asleep. It's a day case, so you should go home the same day.
scenes.speech: A thin, flexible tube with a camera is used to look at the lining of your large bowel. You'll have medicine to make you relaxed and drowsy. You won't be fully asleep. It's a day case, so you should go home the same day.

scenes.title: When and where

stats.label: Where
stats.value: Endoscopy Unit, Ground Floor, Brackenridge General Hospital

scenes.narration: Your appointment is on Wednesday 4 November. Please arrive at 1pm. Go to the Endoscopy Unit, Ground Floor, Brackenridge General Hospital. Expect to be with us for about 4 hours.
scenes.speech: Your appointment is on Wednesday 4 November. Please arrive at 1pm. Go to the Endoscopy Unit, Ground Floor, Brackenridge General Hospital. Expect to be with us for about 4 hours.

scenes.title: Eating and drinking
scenes.narration: This part is important for your safety. Don't eat anything after 9am the day before. You can drink clear fluids until 11am on the day. After that, nothing at all. If you eat or drink after these times, we may have to cancel your procedure.
scenes.speech: This part is important for your safety. Don't eat anything after 9am the day before. You can drink clear fluids until 11am on the day. After that, nothing at all. If you eat or drink after these times, we may have to cancel your procedure.

scenes.title: Bowel preparation

visual.heading: Take your bowel preparation
visual.body: Follow the separate instruction sheet exactly. Stay near a toilet.

scenes.narration: You'll need to take bowel preparation to empty your bowel before the test. Follow the separate sheet exactly. It works quickly, so plan to stay at home, close to a toilet.
scenes.speech: You'll need to take bowel preparation to empty your bowel before the test. Follow the separate sheet exactly. It works quickly, so plan to stay at home, close to a toilet.

scenes.title: Your medicines

items: Stop taking iron tablets 7 days before your appointment.
If you take blood-thinning medicines or medicines for diabetes, call the pre-assessment team. Do not stop them without advice.

scenes.narration: Now, your medicines. Stop taking iron tablets 7 days before your appointment. If you take blood-thinning medicines or medicines for diabetes, call the pre-assessment team. Do not stop them without advice.
scenes.speech: Now, your medicines. Stop taking iron tablets 7 days before your appointment. If you take blood-thinning medicines or medicines for diabetes, call the pre-assessment team. Do not stop them without advice.

scenes.title: What to bring
scenes.narration: Please bring a list of your medicines, a dressing gown and slippers and your bowel preparation instruction sheet. Leave jewellery and valuables at home.
scenes.speech: Please bring a list of your medicines, a dressing gown and slippers and your bowel preparation instruction sheet. Leave jewellery and valuables at home.

scenes.title: Going home

visual.heading: An adult must stay with you for 24 hours
visual.body: Do not drive, cycle or operate machinery for 24 hours after sedation.

scenes.narration: You must have a responsible adult to take you home and stay with you for 24 hours. Do not drive, cycle or operate machinery for 24 hours after sedation. You may feel bloated for a few hours. Most people are back to normal the next day.
scenes.speech: You must have a responsible adult to take you home and stay with you for 24 hours. Do not drive, cycle or operate machinery for 24 hours after sedation. You may feel bloated for a few hours. Most people are back to normal the next day.

scenes.title: When to get help

visual.heading: Call us straight away if you have:
items: Passing more than a small amount of blood

scenes.narration: After you get home, call us straight away if you have any of these: severe tummy pain; passing more than a small amount of blood; a high temperature.
scenes.speech: After you get home, call us straight away if you have any of these: severe tummy pain; passing more than a small amount of blood; a high temperature.
